question: What is the objective of the Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana?

options.text: Helping the poor by providing free food grains.
Helping the poor by providing free house.
Helping the poor by providing skill training.
Helping the poor by providing free food.

solution:
The correct answer is **Helping the poor by providing skill training. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Union Government on 25 September 2014 launched Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Antyodaya Yojana for urban and rural poor.
 
• Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Antyodaya Yojana has two components one for urban India and other for rural India.
 
• The Urban component will be implemented by the Union Ministry of Housing & Urban Poverty Alleviation while rural component named as Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana will be implemented by the Union Ministry of Rural Development.
 
• Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
 
 
• Under the Yojana, the Union Ministry of Rural Development will launch skill development training centres on a large scale to address the problem of unemployment particularly in rural India.
 
• The minimum age for entry under the Yojana is 15 years compared to 18 years under the Aajeevika Skills Programme.
 
 
 
• It aims to enable the rural poor to increase their household income by means of sustainable livelihood.
 
• The scheme started out with an agenda to cover 7 Crore rural poor households via Self Help Groups (SHGs).
